protocol: One round on 20 development items then 80 archived confirmation items per model. Development selected by hash, one per trial. No parameter selection, no test-driven revisions. Stage priority: transport/JSON/schema, numerical validation, quotations, completeness, candidate decision. Only outer whitespace/BOM/one complete JSON fence may be removed in mechanical replay. Row selection uses every parsed row, in source order, with point values hidden; offline scorer accepts all identity- and condition-compatible row IDs. Unknown/no row leads to abstention; conflicting candidates and invalid lists abstain before aggregation. No new data independence claimed.
